heading.en: Slowly, quickly, or with the lid fixed

hook.en: Pump a bicycle tyre quickly and the pump gets hot. Squeeze slowly in a cool room and it does not. How you change a gas decides what happens to it.
hook.kn: ಸೈಕಲ್ ಟೈರ್‌ಗೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಗಾಳಿ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಪಂಪ್ ಬಿಸಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅನಿಲವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ ಎಂಬುದು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Describe state variables and quasi-static processes
Apply isothermal, adiabatic, isochoric and isobaric processes

narration.en: Pump a bicycle tyre quickly and the pump gets hot. Squeeze slowly in a cool room and it does not. How you change a gas decides what happens to it.
narration.kn: ಸೈಕಲ್ ಟೈರ್‌ಗೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಗಾಳಿ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಪಂಪ್ ಬಿಸಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅನಿಲವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ ಎಂಬುದು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: P, V and T are state variables linked by the equation of state PV = μRT. A quasi-static process is so slow that the system is always in equilibrium. In an isothermal process T is constant, so PV = constant, ΔU = 0 and all the heat absorbed becomes work: W = μRT ln(V₂/V₁).
body.kn: P, V, T ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಚರಗಳು; PV = μRT. ಅರೆಸ್ಥಿರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಬಹಳ ನಿಧಾನ. ಸಮೋಷ್ಣೀಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ T ಸ್ಥಿರ, ΔU = 0, ಹೀರಿದ ಉಷ್ಣವೆಲ್ಲಾ ಕೆಲಸವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: W = μRT ln(V₂/V₁).

points.en: Isothermal: PV = constant, ΔU = 0, Q = W

narration.en: P, V and T are state variables linked by the equation of state PV = μRT. A quasi-static process is so slow that the system is always in equilibrium. In an isothermal process T is constant, so PV = constant, ΔU = 0 and all the heat absorbed becomes work: W = μRT ln(V₂/V₁).
narration.kn: P, V, T ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಚರಗಳು; PV = μRT. ಅರೆಸ್ಥಿರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಬಹಳ ನಿಧಾನ. ಸಮೋಷ್ಣೀಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ T ಸ್ಥಿರ, ΔU = 0, ಹೀರಿದ ಉಷ್ಣವೆಲ್ಲಾ ಕೆಲಸವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: W = μRT ln(V₂/V₁).

say.en: On a P–V diagram, draw an isotherm through a point: P V is constant, so it is a hyperbola.
Through the same point, the adiabat P V to the gamma is constant. It is steeper, because the gas also cools as it expands.
Isothermal: T constant, so ΔU is zero and all heat becomes work, mu R T ln of V2 over V1.
Adiabatic: no heat in or out. The work comes from internal energy, so the temperature drops.
Isochoric is a vertical line: no work. Isobaric is a horizontal line: work is P ΔV.
One mole at 300 kelvin doubles its volume isothermally. It does about 1729 joule of work, and absorbs the same heat.

narration.en: On a P–V diagram, draw an isotherm through a point: P V is constant, so it is a hyperbola. Through the same point, the adiabat P V to the gamma is constant. It is steeper, because the gas also cools as it expands. Isothermal: T constant, so ΔU is zero and all heat becomes work, mu R T ln of V2 over V1. Adiabatic: no heat in or out. The work comes from internal energy, so the temperature drops. Isochoric is a vertical line: no work. Isobaric is a horizontal line: work is P ΔV. One mole at 300 kelvin doubles its volume isothermally. It does about 1729 joule of work, and absorbs the same heat.

body.en: In an adiabatic process no heat enters or leaves (Q = 0), so PV^γ = constant and W = μR(T₁ − T₂)/(γ − 1); a gas cools when it expands adiabatically and heats when compressed. In an isochoric process V is constant, so W = 0 and all heat changes U. In an isobaric process P is constant and W = PΔV. In a cyclic process ΔU = 0 over the cycle.
body.kn: ಅಡಿಯಾಬ್ಯಾಟಿಕ್ (ಸ್ಥಿರೋಷ್ಣೀಯ) ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ Q = 0, PV^γ ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಸಮಗಾತ್ರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ W = 0. ಸಮಒತ್ತಡ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ W = PΔV. ಚಕ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ΔU = 0.

narration.en: In an adiabatic process no heat enters or leaves (Q = 0), so PV^γ = constant and W = μR(T₁ − T₂)/(γ − 1); a gas cools when it expands adiabatically and heats when compressed. In an isochoric process V is constant, so W = 0 and all heat changes U. In an isobaric process P is constant and W = PΔV. In a cyclic process ΔU = 0 over the cycle.
narration.kn: ಅಡಿಯಾಬ್ಯಾಟಿಕ್ (ಸ್ಥಿರೋಷ್ಣೀಯ) ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ Q = 0, PV^γ ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಸಮಗಾತ್ರ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ W = 0. ಸಮಒತ್ತಡ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ W = PΔV. ಚಕ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ΔU = 0.

caption.en: Both curves start at (V₀, P₀). The isotherm is PV = const; the adiabat is PV^γ = const and falls faster.

tryThis.en: Which expansion does more work, isothermal or adiabatic? Why?
Move γ towards 1. What happens to the adiabat?

narration.en: Both curves start at (V₀, P₀). The isotherm is PV = const; the adiabat is PV^γ = const and falls faster. Which expansion does more work, isothermal or adiabatic? Why? Move γ towards 1. What happens to the adiabat? Compare γ = 5/3 (monatomic) with 7/5 (diatomic).

problem.en: 1 mol of an ideal gas expands isothermally at 300 K to twice its volume. Find the work done and the heat absorbed. (R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, ln 2 = 0.693)

steps.en: Isothermal, so ΔU = 0 and Q = W ≈ 1.73 kJ.

problem.en: Air (γ = 1.4) at 300 K is compressed adiabatically to half its volume. Find its new temperature. (2^0.4 = 1.32)

body.en: On a P–V diagram the slope of an adiabatic curve is γ times the slope of the isothermal curve through the same point. Since γ > 1 the adiabatic curve is steeper.

homework.en: 2 mol of an ideal gas at 400 K are compressed isothermally to one-third of their volume. Find the work done on the gas (ln 3 = 1.099).

narration.en: Recap. Isothermal: ΔU = 0, Q = W = μRT ln(V₂/V₁). Adiabatic: Q = 0, PV^γ = constant. Isochoric: W = 0; isobaric: W = PΔV. Cyclic process: ΔU = 0.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮೋಷ್ಣೀಯ: ΔU = 0, Q = W. ಅಡಿಯಾಬ್ಯಾಟಿಕ್: Q = 0, PV^γ ಸ್ಥಿರ. ಸಮಗಾತ್ರ: W = 0; ಸಮಒತ್ತಡ: W = PΔV. ಚಕ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ: ΔU = 0.
